title: AttachedSpaEndpoint
description: Validation and metadata schema for Attached SPA dev server endpoints in ReplayFix v1.3.0

host.description: Resolved hostname or IP address of the dev server

port.description: TCP port number where the dev server is listening

reachable.description: Whether TCP socket connectivity and HTTP probe passed

substrate.description: Honest substrate attribution recorded in audit receipt

initial_status_code.description: HTTP status code returned during initial preflight probe
